headline: Pong, the game that started it all
title: Pong 1972 Facts | The First Hit Video Game | Atari | Classic Games
video_script: Pong came out in nineteen seventy two from Atari. Allan Alcorn made it as a training exercise, and the Atari founders liked it so much they decided to sell it. It was the first commercially successful video game, and it helped start the whole video game industry. Have you ever played Pong? Comment below!
description: Pong (1972, Atari) was created by Allan Alcorn as a training exercise; it was the first commercially successful video game and helped establish the industry.
